hostTools.name: gui_terminal_read
hostTools.label: Read terminal
hostTools.description:
Read the user's recent terminal output: an error, a server log, a command they ran.
Read the recent output of the user's terminals in OMPdesk's Terminal panel for this tab (read-only; it cannot type or run anything). Use it when the user refers to something in their terminal. Lists every terminal with its state and returns the last lines of the chosen one (default: the first).

lines.description: How many trailing lines to return; default 200.

hostTools.name: gui_visualize
hostTools.label: Visualize
hostTools.description:
Show the user a page, SVG or image in OMPdesk's Preview panel beside the chat.
Show the user a page, SVG or image you made, or a web page, in OMPdesk's Preview panel beside the chat, and keep each change as a version they can flip through. open: show `target` (a .html/.svg/image file inside the working directory, or an http(s) URL) or `html` (a complete HTML document you write); opening the same file, URL or visual id again adds a version. The user can comment on elements or regions of the page and tweak its CSS variables; that feedback arrives as their next message. check: the shown page's title and console errors. choose: wait for the user to click an element with a data-choice attribute in the page and return its value (use it to let them pick between options you drew). close: remove a visual.

target.description: open: file path (relative to the working directory) or http(s) URL.

html.description: open: a complete HTML document instead of target.

label.description: open: tab title; default the file name or page title.

visual.description: Visual id from an earlier open (required for check, choose, close).

timeout_seconds.description: choose: how long to wait; default 120.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_sessions
controlTools.label: OMPdesk sessions
controlTools.description:
List your open sessions, saved sessions and paired devices.
List sessions: those open in this OMPdesk window (default), in every window of this app (scope app, which includes sessions running on paired devices), or the saved sessions on this computer or a paired device (scope stored: closed ones too, with text search). Each with id, title, folder, device, state (running with its current step, waiting for the user's answer, idle), subagents, todos and the start of its last answer; also the paired devices. An open session's first id is its tab id, this app's own: it differs on another computer and changes when OMPdesk relaunches. Its `saved id` is the session's id everywhere and for good: give that one to another session, and answer a message by the `session` it carries. Sessions the user hid from agents show as private. See skill://ompdesk.

scope.description: window (default), app (every window), or stored (saved sessions, open or not).

device.description: A paired device (Settings › Devices) by name or id; "local" is this computer. ompdesk_sessions lists them. Only that device's sessions.

folder.description: Only sessions whose folder contains this text.

status.description: Open sessions only: running, waiting for the user, or idle.

query.description: Text to find in titles (and, with scope stored, in the conversations).

controlTools.name: ompdesk_session_open
controlTools.label: Open OMPdesk session
controlTools.description:
Open new sessions (tabs) to work in parallel with you; returns ids.
Open new sessions (tabs) so they work in parallel with you; returns their ids. Give one session's fields, or sessions: [...] to fan out. See skill://ompdesk.

message.description: First message; the session starts working on it at once.

folder.description: Working folder (absolute, or relative to yours); default your own folder. On another device: absolute, default its workspace.

device.description: A paired device (Settings › Devices) by name or id; "local" is this computer. ompdesk_sessions lists them. Default: the device your own session runs on.

reopen.description: Open a stored session again instead of a new one: its id from ompdesk_sessions scope stored. It opens in the folder it worked in: worktree and mode do not apply, and folder only when it names that same folder.

restore.description: With reopen: when the session's folder is gone and OMPdesk's disk care saved it, put that worktree back first (its branch, uncommitted work and archived files), then open the session there.

model.description: provider/id, an id from the model list, or one of the person's model roles (task, smol, plan, …), resolved to what that role runs on when the session opens; default the session's default model. A narrow, mechanical implementation: task.

mode.description: plan: plan mode first. goal: the message becomes the session's goal (needs message).

base.description: Start ref: "HEAD" (default: the HEAD of your folder's repo), "default" (the remote's default branch), or any branch, tag or commit the repo resolves.

worktree.description: true: give the session its own git worktree and branch, so parallel sessions never edit the same files.

throwaway.description: true: a one-off session (a lookup, a check). Once its final answer ends with Result: ok and has reached you, OMPdesk closes it and deletes its saved session, on a paired device too. Not with reopen.

sessions.description: Several sessions in one call; instead of the single-session fields.

show.description: background (default) keeps the user's view; focus switches to the first; split-* shows it beside.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_session_send
controlTools.label: Message OMPdesk session
controlTools.description:
Send a message to another open session.
Send a message to any other open session. An idle session starts on it; a running one reads it between its steps (steer, the default). follow_up holds it until that turn ends, and only for a session you opened: to queue its next task behind the one it works on, never for an answer, a result or news it needs now (the user sees a held message waiting in that session's queue). To a session you did not open it goes as steer. A session that shows the user a question card never takes a steer (it would close the card): the message queues behind the card, which stays open, and is read after the user answers. A session blocked in ompdesk_session_result with wait takes a steer at once: its wait returns early. The session sees it as sent by you, an agent: `<ompdesk-agent-message from="<your title>" session="<your saved id>">`, so it answers you by that saved id. The receipt names the session it reached (title, saved id, computer) and what it is doing, and what will actually happen to the message. Pictures and files go along in attachments. It cannot answer that session's pending question: only the user does. See skill://ompdesk.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

delivery.description: For a running session. steer (default): read between its steps. follow_up: held until its turn ends, only for a session you opened (its next task); any other session gets it as steer. A session showing the user a question card always queues it behind the card, whichever you ask.

request_id.description: Your id for this message; sending again with the same id never delivers it twice (returns the first receipt).

path.description: A file on the computer YOUR session runs on: absolute, or relative to your folder.

image.description: The n-th newest picture of YOUR conversation: 1 is the newest (the one the user just pasted, or a tool returned).

attachments.description: Pictures and files to send along; each item is {path} or {image}, exactly one. A picture reaches the session inline, any other file is put on its computer and the message names its path there. Each at most 10 MiB; any number of items; the same bytes twice go once; nothing is sent if one cannot be read.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_report
controlTools.label: Report to OMPdesk opener
controlTools.description:
Report progress or results to the session that opened you.
Tell the session that opened you (or a sibling it opened) about your work, instead of waiting to be asked; or tell a session working in the same checkout (the <shared-checkout> section names it) what you are about to do, or ask it to commit or hold off. Every report reaches a working session between its steps (its tool calls are not cut, a `wait` returns on it). kind: progress (a short status; coalesced; never wakes an idle session), done (the work is finished: summary, changed files, checks you ran; wakes it when idle), question or blocked (you need its decision; wakes it when idle; do not guess meanwhile), review (ready for its review; wakes it when idle), note (to a sibling or a session in the same checkout: e.g. 'I am committing src/a.ts'; never wakes an idle session). A picture or file goes along in attachments. See skill://ompdesk.

text.description: What to tell; for done, the summary.

path.description: A file on the computer YOUR session runs on: absolute, or relative to your folder.

image.description: The n-th newest picture of YOUR conversation: 1 is the newest (the one the user just pasted, or a tool returned).

attachments.description: Pictures and files to send along; each item is {path} or {image}, exactly one. A picture reaches the session inline, any other file is put on its computer and the message names its path there. Each at most 10 MiB; any number of items; the same bytes twice go once; nothing is sent if one cannot be read.

checks.description: done: the checks you ran and whether each passed.

to.description: A sibling's session id (opened by the same session), or a session working in the same checkout; default the session that opened you.

dispatch.description: The dispatch id your task message named; a report for an older dispatch is ignored.

id.description: Your id for this report; a repeat with the same id is delivered once.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_session_result
controlTools.label: Read OMPdesk session result
controlTools.description:
Read another session's last answer and state, optionally waiting for it.
Read the last answer and state of one session (session) or several at once (sessions: a compact table). wait: true waits until they have finished (until all, the default, or any), one needs the user's answer, or the timeout passes; it also returns early, saying so, when a message (a steer or a report) reaches you meanwhile, so you read it at once and may wait again. See skill://ompdesk.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

sessions.description: Several session ids; instead of session.

wait.description: Wait for the state change first; default false.

until.description: With wait and several sessions: all finished (default) or the first one.

timeout_seconds.description: With wait: how long to wait; default 600.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_session_read
controlTools.label: Read OMPdesk session transcript
controlTools.description:
Read another session's transcript, open or stored.
Read the most recent messages of any session's transcript, open or stored (user, assistant, tool calls; bounded). Pass the returned before cursor to page further back. Read-only. See skill://ompdesk.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

before.description: The cursor a previous page returned, for the page before it. A cursor the session has outgrown (it wrote more since, or its tab closed) returns its newest page instead, saying so.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_tab_focus
controlTools.label: Show OMPdesk session
controlTools.description: Show a session to the user: switch to its tab or open it as a split.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

controlTools.name: ompdesk_notify
controlTools.label: Notify the user
controlTools.description:
Show the user a system notification when work finishes or needs them.
Show the user a system notification (for work that finished or needs them while they look elsewhere); clicking it opens this session.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_session_answer
controlTools.label: Answer OMPdesk session question
controlTools.description:
Answer the question another session is waiting on.
Answer the question another session is waiting on (shown by ompdesk_sessions as waiting for the user's answer or for plan approval). The answer is marked as given by an agent. A tool approval or a plan approval is approved only if the user allowed agents to (Settings), else the user must; deny and plan feedback always work. attachments (a picture or file) reach that session first, as a note ahead of the answer; if one cannot be sent, nothing is. See skill://ompdesk.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

path.description: A file on the computer YOUR session runs on: absolute, or relative to your folder.

image.description: The n-th newest picture of YOUR conversation: 1 is the newest (the one the user just pasted, or a tool returned).

attachments.description: Pictures and files to send along; each item is {path} or {image}, exactly one. A picture reaches the session inline, any other file is put on its computer and the message names its path there. Each at most 10 MiB; any number of items; the same bytes twice go once; nothing is sent if one cannot be read.

request.description: Request id when several wait; default the oldest.

choice.description: The option to pick (select questions; a tool approval: Approve, Deny, or stock's "Approve <tool> for this session" when offered, which grants later like calls too). A plan approval: execute (default, fresh context), compact or keep_context.

approve.description: Yes/no for a confirmation, Approve/Deny for a tool approval, approve/reject for a plan (reject with text sends it as feedback).

text.description: Typed answer (input and editor prompts), or a rejected plan's feedback.

answers.description: For a multi-question ask: one entry per question.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_compare
controlTools.label: Compare OMPdesk sessions' work
controlTools.description:
Compare and judge sessions' work: checks, branches, optional ranked verdict.
Compare and judge sessions' work: for each one the final answer, the checks it ran (test, build, lint commands from its transcript, with their outcome) and, for a git worktree, branch, commits ahead, changed files with line counts and uncommitted work. With criteria, a judge model (your slow role) grades each against them and returns a ranked verdict with reasons and a winner. It runs no tests itself. Default: every worktree session you opened. See skill://ompdesk.

sessions.description: Session ids, open or stored; default every worktree session you opened.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria to judge against; without them nothing is judged.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_merge
controlTools.label: Merge an OMPdesk session's branch
controlTools.description:
Merge a worktree session's branch into the parent checkout.
Merge a worktree session's branch into the parent checkout's current branch on the computer the session runs on (a merge commit, never pushed). No card by default; the user confirms first only if they turned off "Let agents manage other sessions". A conflict aborts the merge and lists the files. The repository's .ompdesk/worktree-pre-merge (run in the worktree) must exit 0 before the merge starts, and .ompdesk/worktree-post-merge (run in the parent checkout) runs after it landed; a failing post-merge hook is reported and the merge stays. Refuses when the session or the parent has uncommitted changes. See skill://ompdesk.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

controlTools.name: ompdesk_schedule
controlTools.label: Schedule an OMPdesk run
controlTools.description:
Create, list, change or cancel scheduled runs and routines: on a timer, once, or on an event.
Create, list, change or cancel a scheduled run: a prompt that OMPdesk runs as a fresh print-mode session in a folder, only while the app is open on that device (its Settings › Schedules shows it, marked [agent]). device picks the computer it runs on (default: the one your session runs on). create needs name, prompt and exactly one start: every_minutes, daily_at (HH:MM, optional days 0-6), at or in_minutes (once), or on (an event: webhook, github, files, git, session). With target "self" the prompt is instead delivered into your own session each time (a routine of yours, or a follow-up to check later). update changes an agent-made one by id; pause, resume and run (a test run now) act on one; runs shows its run history with failure reasons. No card by default; the user confirms a new one only if they turned off "Let agents manage other sessions". It never runs with auto-approve, and you can change or cancel only agent-made schedules. See skill://ompdesk.

prompt.description: create, update: what each run is asked; a fresh run has no memory of this conversation. An event run is also told what fired it.

folder.description: create: absolute project folder on that device; default your own (required on another device).

every_minutes.description: create, update: repeat every N minutes (at least 5).

daily_at.description: create, update: local time HH:MM, every day or on days.

at.description: create, update: once, at this moment (ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00+09:00); it then turns itself off.

in_minutes.description: create, update: once, this many minutes from now (a follow-up); it then turns itself off.

on.description: create, update: start on an event instead of a clock. {"source":"webhook"} (POST to this computer's OMPdesk web server, the answer gives the URL path and key; Mobile web must be on); {"source":"github","repo":"owner/name","events":["pull_request"|"issue"|"ci_failure"|"release"|"push"]} (asked with the user's gh every 5 min); {"source":"files","path":"/abs/path"} (a file or folder changed); {"source":"git","repo":"/abs/repo","branch":"main"} (new local commits); {"source":"session","events":["done"|"failed"|"waiting"],"folder":"text"} (another session on this computer finished, failed or waits for the user; never the session a "self" one wakes or ones it opened); {"source":"email","account":"label","from":"text","subject":"text","to":"owner+ci@"} (new mail in a mailbox the user added in Settings › Schedules › Email accounts, by its label, checked every 2 min; from, subject and to are optional text the mail must contain; a reply sent from that mailbox or an automatic mail never starts it; this computer only). Events during a run start one more run after it.

model.description: create, update: provider/id; default omp's default model.

device.description: A paired device (Settings › Devices) by name or id; "local" is this computer. ompdesk_sessions lists them. The computer whose schedules these are. Default: the device your own session runs on.

id.description: cancel, update, pause, resume, run, runs: the schedule id list shows.

target.description: create: "self" delivers the prompt into THIS session at each start, as a message that starts a turn (this session is opened in the background if no tab holds it), instead of running a fresh session: a routine or a follow-up of yours. Give the prompt as a note to yourself, since you keep this conversation. This computer's sessions only; no folder, model or device. A repeating or event one runs until you cancel it; a once one turns itself off.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_autopilot
controlTools.label: OMPdesk Autopilot
controlTools.description:
Start, inspect or stop an unattended Autopilot run on a git repo.
Start, inspect or stop an Autopilot run: an unattended loop that keeps improving a git repo in its own worktree (cycles of audit, change, check, commit; it can push and release when the ship level allows). start opens the run as a new session of yours and returns its id; status reads its cycle, current item, red streak, last commit/push/release and why it paused or ended; stop ends it after the cycle in flight (now: true aborts the turn at once and pauses it). No card by default; the user confirms a start only if they turned off "Let agents manage other sessions", and always for ship release or the repo's default branch. See skill://ompdesk.

folder.description: start: absolute project folder on that device; default your own. On this computer it must be open in a session of this window; on a paired device a session there is opened for it when none has it open.

device.description: A paired device (Settings › Devices) by name or id; "local" is this computer. ompdesk_sessions lists them. start: where the run works (its worktree, checks and shipping run on that computer). Default: the device your own session runs on.

guide.description: start: AUTOPILOT.md text to commit as the run branch's first commit when it differs (default: the repo's own, else one OMPdesk builds; a missing Release section is added from the project's facts).

ship.description: start: how far the run may ship; default commit. release always asks the user.

name.description: new: optional branch name; existing: the branch to work on.

branch.description: start: where the run commits; default a new autopilot/<date> branch.

focus.description: Areas the cycles favour; default all.

cadence.description: With ship release: release every N cycles; default the run decides.

remote.description: Git remote a push goes to; default origin, else the only remote.

limits.description: Ceilings that pause the run; default none.

advanced.description: start: optional tuning; anything omitted keeps the Autopilot sheet's defaults.

session.description: status, stop: the run's session id from start or ompdesk_sessions.

now.description: stop: true aborts the running turn at once (pauses the run); default false.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_session_stop
controlTools.label: Stop OMPdesk session
controlTools.description:
Stop another session's work; optionally close or delete it.
Stop another session's running work; close: true also closes its tab (the session stays saved), delete: true also deletes the saved session (also one no tab holds: its stored id, or the id its tab had before it closed this launch, with device for a paired device's). Sessions you opened, closed ones included: no question asked. Other sessions: stop and close need no card by default (the user may turn that off); deleting one's saved session always asks the user first (a refusal is final). A session the user typed into, or one you did not open that the user looks at, is stopped, closed or deleted only in a turn the user's own message to you started; in a turn another agent's message, a report, a schedule or Autopilot started it is refused. A session you opened that the user only looks at is stopped, closed or deleted at once.

session.description: The session: its saved id (ompdesk_sessions prints it as `saved id`, and a message from a session carries it as `session`; the same on every computer and after a relaunch), its tab id as ompdesk_sessions lists it (this app's own, different on another computer and new after a relaunch; an id it had before a relaunch still works here), a unique prefix of either, or its title (or a unique start of it; refused when several sessions hold it).

close.description: Also close the tab; default false.

delete.description: Also delete the saved session; default false.

device.description: A paired device (Settings › Devices) by name or id; "local" is this computer. ompdesk_sessions lists them. Where a stored session id is saved; default this computer or the last stored list.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_app_list
controlTools.label: OMPdesk app actions
controlTools.description:
List the OMPdesk app actions you can take: settings, panels, usage, models.
List what you can do to OMPdesk itself (settings, side panel, usage, models, saved sessions, updates, sign-in starts) with each action's tier and argument schema. Filter by area or query. See skill://ompdesk/references/app-control.md.

area.description: An area such as settings, ui, usage, models, sessions, updates.

query.description: Words to match in an action's id or description.

controlTools.name: ompdesk_app
controlTools.label: OMPdesk app action
controlTools.description:
Run one OMPdesk app action from ompdesk_app_list.
Do one OMPdesk app action from ompdesk_app_list: change a setting, open a panel, read usage, and so on. Changes are shown to the user with an undo; some actions ask the user first whatever their settings say (they erase data, install code, start a sign-in, change the proxy, expose the computer or end running work); some are never available. See skill://ompdesk/references/app-control.md.

action.description: Action id from ompdesk_app_list, e.g. settings.theme.

args.description: The action's arguments as its schema says.
